cache_model.statement: The foreground code and data working set targets 20 MiB on a 32 MiB LLC, leaving 12 MiB for associativity loss and competing activity. This is unproved until a rank-1 locality sweep measures it.

covered: browser chrome event and damage paths
HTML, CSS, layout, paint, and scheduler hot state
bounded JavaScript runtime core used by the foreground page
excluded: large page JavaScript heaps and WebAssembly memories
optional_hardware_measurements: LLC loads and LLC load misses

gates.reason: Counter semantics and cache topology vary by host, and no controlled working-set sweep has established portable thresholds.
